name: modal

native.scope: Native declaration, admitted child slots, and browser lifecycle integration are not yet verified.

summary: Presents a focused native dialog while retaining a real destination when enhancement is unavailable.

agent.useWhen: A short, interruptive task needs protected focus and a real fallback destination.
agent.avoidWhen: The task is non-interruptive, lengthy, or better represented as a page or disclosure.

invariants: Modal options are typed plain data; body and optional actions are separate host-admitted slots.
fallbackHref must be a safe real destination and remains navigable if dialog enhancement is unavailable.
Native dialog top-layer, Escape, and focus semantics are preserved; JavaScript only enhances the fallback link.
Derived IDs are id and id-title and must be reserved against page collisions.
Only the component's delegated click behavior is installed by the host lifecycle; no global auto-run or app operation is owned.
Adapter fragment has exactly one [[modal]] slot.
